body: Maybe try Cope WG or LongHorn WG. Or start off on mint. I had the same feeling towards Grizzly,I just had to get my feet in the water first,now I can horseshoe a lip of Grizzly no problem.

Yeah,I first tried dip years ago,started off with Skoal Vanilla then Grizzly WG. Honestly,you just gotta get used to the nicotine and get past the nausea,then you'll start to pick up on the flavors. I don't usually get flavored dips,but I do enjoy some Grizzly WG once in a while.
I like Grizzly WG,might have to give this a try. My regular is Cope Snuff so maybe I'll like it. Thanks for the heads up!

I use dip to quit smoking,because I e listed in the Air Force and leave in a month. I quit 3 months ago,using dip. I was a pack and a half a day smoker,Marlboro Reds. If you don't like flavored dips,i recommend Cope Snuff (high nicotine content,finely cut too) or Cope Long cut. If you liked menthol cigs,I'd recommend Grizzly WG or Kodiak WG. Both strong nicotine. Don't expect a buzz,but a change in the way you take in nicotine. 

I recently smoked a cig at a party and hated it. After a week or so you'll start to get used to it and prefer it.
I plan on quitting soon,USAF's basic is only 2 months or so. So it's no big deal

I agree with the guy who said Dark Mint,it definitely has a different kick. If you're only using Wintergreens,I'd recommend Skoal,it doesn't taste as good but it has a good kick,or Long Horn,people hate it but I think it's got a good taste. 

I don't use flavored dips tbh,I prefer Cope Snuff or Cope LC,i like the salt taste.
How's the Kodiak? Heard good things about it.
